screening_decisions.reason: This is a review article about staging criteria for endometrial cancer, not an RCT comparing chemotherapy interventions.
RCT comparing two chemotherapy regimens (doxorubicin alone vs doxorubicin+cyclophosphamide) in patients with advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Phase III RCT comparing two chemotherapy regimens in advanced endometrial cancer. Both arms contain chemotherapy, meeting the criteria for comparing different chemotherapy.
This is a methodology paper about standardization of reporting cancer treatment results, not a clinical trial.
Retrospective review of surgical treatment (pelvic exenteration), not an RCT comparing chemotherapy.
RCT comparing two single-agent chemotherapy regimens (adriamycin vs cyclophosphamide) in patients with advanced endometrial cancer. Meets inclusion criteria.
RCT comparing chemotherapy regimens (cisplatin alone vs CAP combination) in patients with metastatic endometrial carcinoma. Meets inclusion criteria.
RCT comparing two chemotherapy agents (cyclophosphamide vs ifosfamide) in patients with recurrent or metastatic endometrial adenocarcinoma. Meets inclusion criteria.
This is an overview of beta blocker trials for myocardial infarction, not related to endometrial cancer or chemotherapy.
RCT comparing two chemotherapy regimens in patients with advanced (FIGO stages III and IV) or recurrent endometrial cancer. Meets inclusion criteria.
Methodology paper about meta-analysis techniques, not a clinical trial.
Phase III RCT comparing two chemotherapy regimens (MVAC vs AC) in patients with advanced endometrial cancer. Meets inclusion criteria.
Phase III RCT comparing chemotherapy regimens (AP vs TAP) in women with advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma. Meets inclusion criteria.
RCT for non-small cell lung cancer, not endometrial cancer. Wrong disease population.

Review article about surgical staging and lymphadenectomy, not an RCT comparing chemotherapy.
